message: every halving of the step must reduce the error, and no error may be exactly zero
observed convergence order at each refinement; a lower-order method still satisfies every other gate in this repository
spread of J across 100 orbits — RK4 is not symplectic, so this is a bound rather than an equality
a drift-free orbit must still return to its start after 100 periods, not merely after one
closure error at 100 orbits against 50 orbits; linear accumulation is fine, compounding is not
